name: Lauren Young Tire

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial facility with a multi-section white metal building in an L-shaped configuration|A large paved parking lot with marked spaces is located in front of the building|Extensive rows of tires are stored outdoors along the sides and rear of the facility|The site has open paved areas and has street frontage.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main building facade with multiple service bays and garage openings|A large paved customer parking lot with marked spaces is located directly in front of the building|Tire storage is visible at the rear of the property|The site has clear street frontage and access from Industrial Way.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side of the main building with service areas|Large quantities of tires are stored in organized rows along this side of the property|Paved areas provide vehicle movement around the building and storage zones.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back of the multi-section building with additional service and storage areas|Extensive outdoor tire storage occupies much of the rear and side portions of the lot|Open paved areas allow vehicle movement around the site.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the main building and large outdoor tire storage areas|Rows of tires are arranged along the perimeter of the paved lot|The property has space to move around the property and direct access from the street.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Industrial Way into the large paved parking and movement around the building. The open layout provides good space for emergency vehicle staging in front and around the sides of the facility. Extensive outdoor tire storage occupies significant portions of the sides and rear and may limit movement in those zones. The main building has multiple service bay openings. The facility is located in an industrial area with good road access.
clarifications: Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the main building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building itself? Is vehicle access available through all areas of the tire storage zones? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the rear or storage areas of the facility?
